card.name: Has been reported with antibacterial agents
card.fires_on: The word "with" (or "reported") right after "has been reported" in the C. difficile-associated diarrhea warning, just before "use of nearly all antibacterial agents".

modes.label: C. difficile warning
modes.description: "with" after "has been reported" in the CDAD warning about nearly all antibacterial agents.

modes.label: Other "has been reported"
modes.description: "reported" itself in a similar warning statement about a syndrome seen in treated patients.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens do not point to a clear output effect on the label text; they favor past-time words and suppress frequency words like "often".
card.plain: It marks the spot in the standard warning where a side effect is said to have been reported with nearly all antibiotics.
